data.body: RP-03 retry-ownership approval checkpoint (2026-08-17). Maintainer approved the two-level extension pattern: concrete adapters exclusively own authorized physical replay and provider transport mechanics; the backend-neutral reconciler owns semantic re-observation/recovery, `commit_unknown`, dependency/deferral/fuse policy, and pass outcomes; `jira_family` remains retry-free and pure. Immediate replay requires both core-declared semantic permission and adapter proof that the exact request was not applied, provider-idempotent, or freshly deduplicated. Compound methods cannot be replayed wholesale after partial success. SDK retries are disabled where configurable, opaque CLI retries are not multiplied, and physical attempts are distinct from logical operations. Future GitHub Issues/Linear adapters are architectural consumers but remain out of RP-03 scope. Detailed addendum: `.joe-janitor/rp03-jira-failure-taxonomy.md` and `.joe-janitor/rp03-outbound-lifecycle-research.md`. No RP-04 ticket, worktree, or implementation state was touched.
